free_tier.stated: Docs page states verbatim: "Uživatel může schránku využívat v neomezené velikosti. V praxi je každá schránka založena s limitem na 120 000 zpráv, který lze opakovaně navyšovat." = unlimited mailbox size; in practice each mailbox starts with a 120,000-message limit that can be raised repeatedly (on request). This is the only webmail found where the published limit is a MESSAGE COUNT, not a byte quota.

egress.terms: Unmetered by the provider. No transfer meter is published or charged; mail is delivered by SMTP/IMAP, not metered HTTP GET. No egress pricing exists for a mailbox.

record.tooling: Native IMAP, probe-verified live: `imap.seznam.cz:993` -> `* OK Seznam IMAP server ready` / `* CAPABILITY XLIST IMAP4rev1 AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=LOGIN AUTH=OAUTHBEARER AUTH=XOAUTH2 SASL-IR CHILDREN SORT I18NLEVEL=1 UIDPLUS ID MOVE UNSELECT`. Any IMAP client or imapsync/offlineimap works. No rclone backend.
record.chaining: Each account is byte-unlimited (message-count-bound), so a second account carries a second allowance. 120,000 messages × the 35 MB send cap = ~4.2 TB per account before the message-count ceiling even binds; raise the count via support and the ceiling moves. Free registration, no paid tier required.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 35 MB attach send from web (25 MB from mobile app), 50 MB receive per message. That is the real per-blob size. 120,000 messages/mailbox is the binding constraint (a pull-count-style ceiling on object count, raisable on request). Sending-rate limits exist but are explicitly unpublished: "Tyto limity nejsou veřejné.".
record.reliability_note: Operators state up front that they watch for excess use of the unlimited claim: rules are tuned to catch anyone probing "kde je ta skutečná hranice" (where the real boundary is). Message-count ceiling is enforced silently at fill time.

evidence.proved: "neomezené velikosti" + "120 000 zpráv" + 35/50 MB attach caps, read live 2026-10-21
probe: openssl s_client -connect imap.seznam.cz:993 -> * OK Seznam IMAP server ready + CAPABILITY incl. AUTH=PLAIN/OAUTHBEARER
